_meta.description: Coordinate samples from the legacy NASA PDS Lunar Prospector hydrogen half-degree grid. Preserved as historical comparison only; not used as current site hydrogen values.
_meta.method: Selected the row whose min-inclusive/max-exclusive latitude and longitude bounds contain the site coordinate. For sites whose contract longitude exceeds 180 degrees east, subtracted 360 degrees to match the source grid's -180 to +180 east-positive longitudes. Reported the exact source cell bounds and source value without clipping or adjustment.
limitations: The PDS source identifies this as a special product, not a peer-reviewed PDS archive product.
The PDS page warns that hydrogen estimates may be unreliable in regions with high thorium and rare-earth element abundances.
The file supplies no per-cell standard deviation.
Two sampled site values are negative ppm and therefore cannot be interpreted as physical hydrogen abundance.
The newer 2022 global map is still the preferred candidate for site estimates, but has not yet been retrieved and sampled.
